title: Benefit Periods of Dollar-Budget Programs in the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Copay Programs Administration standard for the benefit periods of programs in the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs that have a dollar budget.

### 1. Opening and crediting a period

The clause "a program with a dollar budget opens a benefit period at activation and at the start of each new period under its benefit-period basis, crediting the program dollars per benefit period" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

### 2. Dollars left at the end of a period

The clause "a period's dollars belong to that period only: when the period ends, or the program expires or is cancelled, whatever is left is closed out and never carried into the next period" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

### 3. Opening only while active (in force)

A benefit period is opened only while the enrollment is in active status. The status is read from the enrollment record before the period is opened.

| Enrollment status | May a benefit period be opened? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Pending activation, suspended, expired or cancelled | No |

### 4. Once each (in force)

A period is opened and closed once each. A benefit period that already carries its opening is not opened again, and one that already carries its close is not closed again.

superseded_clauses: A program with a dollar budget opens a benefit period at activation and at the start of each new period under its benefit_period_basis, crediting annual_benefit_max_usd.
A period's dollars belong to that period only: when the period ends, or the program expires or is cancelled, whatever is left is closed out and never carried into the next period.
